data.title: PublicSquare Expands Embedded Payments Distribution with LendSuite Software Integration
data.description: In Bozeman, Montana, PSQ Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: PSQH) revealed that PSQ Payments is teaming up with LendSuite Software to offer payment processing services to around 150 lenders in its network. This collaboration enables lenders on platforms like Infinity Software, Tekambi, and EPIC Loan Systems to utilize PSQ Payments for card, ACH, RTP, FedNow, and Push to transactions.

data.title: Klarna to Present at Upcoming Investor Conference
data.description: New York - Klarna, the everyday finance network, revealed its plans to participate in the upcoming investor conference in September. The company will be present at the Goldman Sachs Communacopia + Technology Conference on September 9 at 3:05 p.m. PDT, with Niclas Neglen, CFO, representing Klarna. Those interested can access live webcasts and archived replays of the event via Klarna’s investor relations website at investors.klarna.com. Klarna boasts a vast network, with over 120 million active users worldwide and facilitating 3.8 million transactions.

data.title: The Arena Group d/b/a Paradium.AI Announces Intent to Change Legal Name and Stock Ticker
data.description: In New York, the Arena Group Holdings, operating as Paradium.AI (NYSE American: AREN), a prominent technology and brand company housing various well-known brands such as Parade, TheStreet, Men’s Journal, Athlon Sports, ShopHQ, and Adventure Sports Network (Surfer, Powder, Bike Magazine, etc.), revealed plans to alter its legal name and stock ticker symbol by August 31, 2026. The Company's proposed name change signifies a strategic shift in its corporate identity.

data.title: AMC Robotics Enters into Warrant Inducement Transaction for up to $2.1 Million in Gross Proceeds
data.description: On August 21, 2026, AMC Robotics Corporation (Nasdaq: AMCI) announced entering warrant inducement agreements with two investors for the exercise of certain outstanding warrants issued in December 2025. The investors agreed to exercise these warrants at a reduced price of $1.65, generating $1 million in gross proceeds through the Initial Warrant Exercise. Additionally, they have the option to exercise the remaining warrants at the same reduced price, potentially raising up to an additional $1.1 million within 30 trading days. Currently priced at $4.017 per share, the warrants allow for the acquisition of common stock. This resale has been registered under an effective Form S-1 (File No. 333-292488).

data.title: RenovoRx Regains Compliance with Nasdaq Minimum Bid Price Requirement
data.description: RenovoRx, Inc., a biotech company based in Mountain View, California, has successfully regained compliance with the Nasdaq Stock Market LLC's minimum bid price requirement for continued listing on The Nasdaq Capital Market. The company, trading under the symbol RNXT, focuses on developing targeted oncology therapies and distributing their patented FDA-cleared drug delivery device, RenovoCath®. This recent development was announced on August 21, 2026, signifying the company's commitment to meeting market standards and maintaining its foothold in the industry.

data.title: Star Equity Holdings, Inc. Declares Cash Dividend of $0.25 Per Share of 10% Series A Cumulative Perpetual Preferred Stock
data.description: Star Equity Holdings, Inc. headquartered in Old Greenwich, Conn., revealed that its Board of Directors declared a cash dividend for holders of the Company’s 10% Series A Cumulative Perpetual Preferred Stock, with a payout of $0.25 per share. The record date for eligibility to receive this dividend is set for September 1, 2026, while the payment date is scheduled for September 10, 2026. The Company is listed on Nasdaq under the tickers STRR and STRRP.

data.title: Vivakor Reports Positive Operating Income as Second Quarter Revenue Increases 10% to $32.1 Million
data.description: Dallas, Texas, August 21, 2026 - Vivakor, Inc. (Nasdaq: VIVK), a company offering energy transportation, storage, reuse, and remediation services, revealed its financial performance for the second quarter and first half of 2026. The results showcased notable achievements, including growth in second-quarter revenue, a substantial 45% rise in second-quarter gross profit, and a turnaround to positive operating income. These figures indicate strong performance and positive momentum for Vivakor in the energy sector.

data.title: AmeriHealth Caritas Makes Strategic Investment in Deon Health
data.description: AmeriHealth Caritas has recently revealed its strategic investment in Michigan's Deon Health, a specialty managed care organization focused on individuals with intellectual and developmental disabilities (I/DD). This investment aims to bolster Deon Health's efforts in providing specialized and coordinated care for those with I/DD. The organization's care model prioritizes individual requirements, preferences, and community integration, enabled by tailor-made technology solutions.

data.title: reAlpha (NASDAQ: AIRE) Completes InstaMortgage Acquisition, Adding Direct Lending Capabilities to Company’s Integrated Platform
data.description: An acquisition has bolstered reAlpha's integrated mortgage platform by incorporating multi-state direct lending services with in-house underwriting and funding. This move has widened reAlpha's reach to 38 states and Washington, D.C.

data.title: Havila Kystruten AS: Q2 2026 Earnings Call Presentation Invitation.
data.description: In a recent report, it was revealed that the global population has reached a record high of 7.9 billion people. The report also highlighted that the COVID-19 pandemic has led to approximately 200 million job losses worldwide. Furthermore, global carbon dioxide emissions have decreased by 7% in 2020 due to lockdown measures imposed during the pandemic. It was noted that the United States has the highest number of COVID-19 cases with over 30 million confirmed infections. The report also indicated that the global economy contracted by 3.5% in 2020, marking the steepest decline since the Great Depression. Despite these challenges, efforts are being made to accelerate vaccination campaigns and revive economic growth in various countries.

data.title: Sky Harbour Announces Increase to Recent Registered Direct Common Stock Placement, Updates Investor Conference Calendar, and Announces Filing of Construction Reports
data.description: A company in aviation infrastructure, Sky Harbour Group Corporation (NYSE: SKYH, SKYH WS), based in West Harrison, N.Y., is making strides in establishing the initial nationwide network of Home Base Operator (HBO) campuses for business aircraft. The company, also known as SHG, revealed its upcoming investor conferences scheduled for the next two months. Additionally, it submitted its monthly construction reports as part of its operational updates. Moreover, the company boosted its recent registered direct common stock placement by $10 million with the participation of an extra strategic investor.
